question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
Which couple would you like to see more of?
Did you ever attend a Valentine's Day Ball?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: ...And that's it!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: That sounds perfect! The store's going to close soon. Anything else we need to buy?
$Scott runs around the store, getting items for the different requests until...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Did you get everything?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I bought cheese and chips for the nacho stand, a disco ball and cones for the ballroom dance floor...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Dark curtains for the make-out corner, balloon animals...
$Scott and Angie run around the store, getting items for the different requests until...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Did you get everything?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I bought apples, a fake tree, plastic snakes, and stuffed animals...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: That doesn't sound right at all!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I wish I hadn't forgotten that list...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: It's okay, we can put it all back and come here tomorrow... Wait, did you say you `bought` everything already?!
nodes.text_bbcode: It's okay, we can put it all back and come here tomorrow... Wait, did you say you [color=#3b78e2][i]bought[/i][/color] everything already?!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I may have done that. Bought stuff. Like unreturnable, nonrefundable items.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: $Scott, that was all the money we budgeted for supplies!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: There's still a little left.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Is there anything else we had to get? Something that's actually on the list?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: It's right on the tip of my tongue! I just can't think of it.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Well, the store's closing. We have to leave without it, $Scott.
Angie leads $Scott out of the store.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Thanks, Mac!

nodes.speaker: Mac
nodes.text: No problem, kiddo. Just holler if you need anything else.
Mac leaves to tend to the front of the store.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: So besides the crown, what else is on the list?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: The list?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: The list we made right before we left with everyone's requests on it? The one we're using to buy the supplies?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: That list is...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: ...On my desk at school.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: But don't worry. I know what's on it. Cheese, chips, uh... Balloon animals...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Balloon animals?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: It's one of the anonymous requests. Anyway, I'm sure I can remember what everyone wanted if we shop around for a while.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Though Taylor did specifically say she wanted the most glamorous `crown...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Though Taylor did specifically say she wanted the most glamorous [color=#e23b3b][i]crown...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: That's probably the best choice. I don't think she'll care. It'll be better than wearing a belt.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: But the gem in the center isn't even real. I can't imagine Taylor liking it.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I'm sure she'll be okay. A crown's a crown, right?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Right...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Are you sure, $Scott? I mean, it's a nice belt, but it's a `belt.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Are you sure, $Scott? I mean, it's a nice belt, but it's a [color=#3b78e2][i]belt.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: And wrestling champions win belts. Why can't queens?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Even Taylor will have to admit this is the most amazing belt ever! And everything on it is real...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Taylor did specifically say 'real gemstones'.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Exactly!
Dex wanders happily off as Taylor, Sam, and Amanda approach $Scott.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Next up is Taylor. She just put in a picture of a diamond.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Hello, President. I'm here about my crown.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: `Your` crown? Taylor, you know there are four other candidates for Queen of Hearts, and two of them are standing next to you.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Your[/i][/color] crown? Taylor, you know there are four other candidates for Queen of Hearts, and two of them are standing next to you.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I'm voting for Taylor.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Me too.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: See? Naturally, as the most popular girl, I'm going to win. And you can't be queen without a crown.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Of course. I want my crown to be glamorous. And I shouldn't have to remind you that a real queen wears real gems, right?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Are you sure you want a crown? Last time we had one, it was part of an elaborate plot to frame Paula...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Exactly! It was great!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Sure.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Thanks. Oh, and $Scott, I'm not happy you're leaving all the details up to the masses. The dance has to be perfect.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I don't want my kingdom to be filled with nerdy things and skateboard ramps and snow machines.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Man, why does everyone still have to bring up the snow machine incident?!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I mean, don't worry about it, Taylor. I'll personally make sure the dance runs smoothly.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'll hold you to that.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Vote for Taylor!
Taylor steps back as Amanda comes up to $Scott.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: And, finally, we have Amanda. She drew us a picture of a sparkly unicorn.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Hi, $Scott... There's one thing I want to see at the dance.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Amanda, I... I hate to break the news to you... But there's no way I can get a unicorn to the dance...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Don't be silly, $Scott. Everyone knows unicorns only live in Canada! I'm not some kind of dummy! Geez...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I just wanted to ask if there would be glitter!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Now that I can definitely promise will be there.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Tee hee!
Amanda walks off.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: That's the last of the suggestions. We've gone through all of the ones we could address, but you'll have to take care of the rest of them at the dance.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Of course. I've learned my lesson, Angie. It's not enough just to plan the dance... I'm going to see it through.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: All right, Angie. Time to get supplies!
And later, at the party superstore, $Scott approaches the jewelry counter where Mac is standing.

nodes.speaker: Mac
nodes.text: Hey, short-stop! Here for some jewelry for your little woman?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Little woman?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Not quite, Mac... I'm throwing another party, and I need a crown. The fanciest crown with real jewels that you have.

nodes.speaker: Mac
nodes.text: Well, we have this one over here with some real shiners at $500...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Er, maybe the cheapest crown you have.
Mac brings out a cheap plastic crown with a small gem in the center of it.

nodes.speaker: Mac
nodes.text: Here's a much simpler one for the Frugal Fred. The stone isn't real, of course, but I think this is what you're looking for.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: You have anything else?

nodes.speaker: Mac
nodes.text: Not for crowns. But you know, if you want something circular, I have just the thing... Limited-edition, mint-condition jeweled belts! These were to be our premiere Valentine's Day items...
Mac pulls out a wide, black belt studded with rubies and amethysts.

nodes.speaker: Mac
nodes.text: But the girls didn't go star-eyed over them like I thought they would... Can't see why though.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: That looks like a saddle.

nodes.speaker: Mac
nodes.text: Maybe you've got a point, little lady.

nodes.speaker: Mac
nodes.text: But this is the cheapest item with the real-est gemstones in the store. So what do you say? The crown or the belt?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I'll go with...

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Uh, what?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Usually the dress code for dances is formal, but since I can't give you your spaceship, you can dress however you want.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Wow... Thanks, $Scott!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: I'll mobilize our forces immediately!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: The guys will be excited to wear the orcs and goblins costumes we got at the Warscrewdriver Online Convention!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: The who and the what now?!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Thanks, $Scott!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Uh, er, okay...

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Come again?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Dex, you hand me a schematic for a spaceship, you get a spaceship.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: A real one?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: No. But if we string up some Christmas lights and put silver paint on the wall, we'll turn the gym into our very own spaceship from that scifi series I can never remember...

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Star Tracks?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Yeah, that one.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Thanks, $Scott!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: That's what I'm here for.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I would recommend we make everyone submit their comments and suggestions, and we'll go through them in an orderly manner.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Oh, I was just going to set it out and see what happens.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: We're doomed.
The following week, the students swarm en masse into the Student Lounge to talk to $Scott, Angie, and Justin.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Hey, $Scott! Did you get my suggestion for the ballroom dance floor?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Yeah, $Scott, what about my idea for 'Ryan's Make-Out Corner'?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: And did you need help installing the nacho station, $Scott?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Just write your ideas down and put the suggestions in the box... `In the box!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Just write your ideas down and put the suggestions in the box... [color=#e23b3b][i]In the box![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Now you see the folly of this idea?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: But people like making suggestions... They're just a little `overly` excited.
nodes.text_bbcode: But people like making suggestions... They're just a little [color=#e23b3b][i]overly[/i][/color] excited.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: It's not a disaster, Justin. We can make this work. We just need a little... Order.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: All right, everyone! We received all your written suggestions. There's no need to crowd our President. If we have a question about your suggestion, we'll call you up.
In a few minutes, the crowd disperses, and only a handful of students are left.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: There we go. Okay. I've color-coded and organized all the suggestions by name and complexity of request. We just have a few left to address.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: First up is Dex, who put in an interesting request...

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Greetings, President.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: How can I help?
Dexter plunks a sheet of paper down on the desk, and $Scott looks it over.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: This is just a picture of a spaceship orbiting earth.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Not precisely. It's the schematic for one. We want the Valentine's Day Ball there.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: You want us to have the Valentine's Day Ball `in outer space?`
nodes.text_bbcode: You want us to have the Valentine's Day Ball [color=#e23b3b][i]in outer space?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I like the way you think, but I don't know about making out in Zero G...

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: What? No! Not outer space. Just in a spacecraft. A replica of the 'Undertaking' from Star Tracks!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I'm going to be the first to say this would be kinda cool, but don't you think spaceships are a little out of theme for Valentine's Day?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Look, $Scott, the nerds are often overlooked in the proceedings of the popular.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: We can't express ourselves through dress without ridicule, we're often crammed into tight spaces, and no one respects our interests.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: We want a nod in our direction, just this once.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I understand, Dex. You know what? This time...

options.label: You can dress however you want!
We'll have the dance in a spaceship!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: What kind of government would we be if we didn't ask the students what they thought?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: If people really wanted to make their own decisions, they wouldn't have elected us to do it for them.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: You're assuming people actually voted for you...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Well, I know `I` certainly did...
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, I know [color=#e23b3b][i]I[/i][/color] certainly did...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Well, $Scott, that's exactly what I like to hear from the President.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Funny, that's me.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Hee hee.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: All right, love birds. What are you planning to do with this thing, $Scott?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: The surprise for Winter Formal was `spontaneous,` and we all know how fun that snow machine turned out...
nodes.text_bbcode: The surprise for Winter Formal was [color=#e23b3b][i]spontaneous,[/i][/color] and we all know how fun that snow machine turned out...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Someday people are going to forget about that.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Not if I keep bringing it up.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: $Scott, I agree that it could be fun, but... We have a responsibility to our constituents.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: And they voted us into office, so we could meet their needs.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I'm just saying, things can be way more fun if we're not so rigid. Too much prep and organizing takes all the life out of a party.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: $Scott, prep and organization `make` the party. We can't just hand off all the party planning to the student body without `some` order.
nodes.text_bbcode: $Scott, prep and organization [color=#3b78e2][i]make[/i][/color] the party. We can't just hand off all the party planning to the student body without [color=#3b78e2][i]some[/i][/color] order.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Maybe I'm going about this the wrong way.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I just think we could use student feedback to be sure we're planning the party they want.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Well, that does sound better. How do you want to implement the suggestion box?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: We've been receiving a lot of complaints about how badly the Valentine's Day Ball went last year...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Who knew that Cupid bow was full of real arrows?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Exactly. Which is why we're having this meeting.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Even though the push for the Valentine's Day Ball and the Queen of Hearts election was Taylor's idea, the ball is for everyone.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: And I want to make sure we're doing something that will make everyone happy.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I'll admit, I haven't always been the best judge of what people would enjoy... So this time, I'm going to make `sure` I give the people what they want.
nodes.text_bbcode: I'll admit, I haven't always been the best judge of what people would enjoy... So this time, I'm going to make [color=#e23b3b][i]sure[/i][/color] I give the people what they want.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Folly.
Scott points to the center of the conference table where an object sits under a tablecloth.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Behold...
Scott tears away the cloth to reveal a simple wooden box with a hole in the top.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: ...The suggestion box!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Ha ha... Ha ha ha! You must be joking.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: $Scott, you know that I always support you. But basing the entire dance off a suggestion box this close to the event?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I know it's not the usual method, but come on, it's...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: As a matter of fact, I believe I can.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: If it were up to you, Justin, all our dances would be SAT-prep themed.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Wrong! If it were up to me, we wouldn't have dances at all!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Ahem, President and Vice President!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: We're not here to argue. We're here to organize the `Valentine's Day Ball.`
nodes.text_bbcode: We're not here to argue. We're here to organize the [color=#3b78e2][i]Valentine's Day Ball.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Which our President has no good plan for.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: You're the VP, Justin. Your job isn't to oust me. It's to focus on the student body.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: And what the student body wants right now is a fun and functional `Valentine's Day Ball.`
nodes.text_bbcode: And what the student body wants right now is a fun and functional [color=#e23b3b][i]Valentine's Day Ball.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I suppose you're right.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: So tell us what your brilliant scheme is this time, President.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Looks like you did it though!
Around $Scott and Angie, students mosh around and bump into each other.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Yeah!!!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Whoo!

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Pushing people around is awesome!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I feel pretty good about that.
$Scott and Angie happily make their way off the dance floor.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Well, that's settled. Come on, girls, time to line up and get out there.
Taylor, Linda, Sam, $ZOE, and Amanda line up, and Angie opens the door to the green room...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Then you won't have to walk alone, and we can still keep up tradition.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: You `would` say that. That totally defeats the purpose, $Scott!
nodes.text_bbcode: You [color=#3b78e2][i]would[/i][/color] say that. That totally defeats the purpose, $Scott!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: And it seems like you haven't thought this through. Who is Angie going to walk with?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: It's okay, Linda... It's $Scott's job as President to make sacrifices. This is for the greater good.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I'll just lead the procession.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: All right, fine.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Really? You'd change that for me?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: You make a good point, Linda. You shouldn't have to walk down with a date if you don't have one.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Thanks, $Scott!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What?! What about our dates?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: The Queen of Hearts can't walk down the red carpet alone.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: You won't be alone. You'll just be walking with all the other girls at the same time, Taylor.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: All right, fine.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Looks like it didn't work.
$Scott surveys his handiwork and finds the dance floor dead as other students walk off.

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: This sucks!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: It's just the same lame dance it is every year.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: That could've gone a lot better.
$Scott and Angie dejectedly make their way off the dance floor.
$Scott pushes Jacob and runs away!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Hey!
Jacob turns around angrily only to see Maria.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Oh... Hey, Maria.
Jacob nudges Maria, and Maria playfully pushes him back.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Hey yourself. Tee hee.
Soon all the jocks and the popular girls are jumping around!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Well, I don't think Jacob minds.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: But I still feel kind of bad for body-checking a basketball player...
$Scott pushes Zach!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: You want some of this, $Scott?! `Zach Attack!`
nodes.text_bbcode: You want some of this, $Scott?! [color=#e23b3b][i]Zach Attack![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Zach tackles $Scott, and they crash into a table!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Ha ha, let's try that again!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Let's not.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Anyone else want some of this? Dex!
Zach tackles Dex, as $Scott hobbles back to Angie.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Remind me `never` to push a `football player` again...
nodes.text_bbcode: Remind me [color=#e23b3b][i]never[/i][/color] to push a [color=#e23b3b][i]football player[/i][/color] again...

nodes.text: $Scott freezes on the spot!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: $Scott, what are you doing?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Sorry, Angie. I don't know what came over me.
$Scott jumps into Erik!
Erik staggers but jumps to stay on his feet.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: That was... Fun!
Erik pushes Dex who bounces back.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: It's like being in an anti-gravity chamber!
The nerds start jumping around!
$Scott pushes Dex!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Ack! Unidentified force! Duck and cover, duck and cover!
Dex drops to the floor in the fetal position, putting his arms over his head.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: That's great technique. But for what, I'm not quite sure.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: He should hold some sort of record for that.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: But that's not going to make a mosh pit...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Why don't you try the jocks?
$Scott hesitates.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Shouldn't you move or something?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I don't know about the nerds, Angie. Let's try getting the jocks...
$Scott jumps into Jessica!
Jessica falls into Maria.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ow, $Scott! What are you doing? I just tanned that arm!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Yeah, $Scott, that was kind of mean.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Sorry, girls...
$Scott walks away as the cheerleaders glare behind his back.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: That didn't go so well. Maybe try the nerds instead?
$Scott jumps into Kenji!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Who ran into me?!
Kenji pushes Spike!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Hey, what gives, Kenji?
$Scott ducks out of the mayhem, as Spike shoves Kenji.
The rebels start pushing each other and jumping around!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: All right! Let's try the nerds now...
$Scott freezes!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I thought the plan was to push someone!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Maybe if we should get the nerds moving first...
At that moment, Travis and Megan walk up to them.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Hey, Prez, how's it going?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Hey, Megan. Travis is your, uh, date?

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: You got a problem with that?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: No, I think it's great!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Listen, did you read over what Travis and I wanted for the dance?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Remind me again what that was?

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Swing dancing is a little lame. What we really want is a mosh pit!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: A mosh pit? We can make that happen.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: But... Should we?

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Thanks, $Scott. We can keep it going if you get it started.
$Scott and Angie follow Megan and Travis onto the regular dance floor.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: How are you going to make a mosh pit?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Start jumping up and down and running into people... Now, who do I push first?
$Scott takes Angie in his arms and allows her to lead them.
They waltz in a large circle around the dance floor!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Why didn't you tell me you could dance like that?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I like to keep you on your toes. Besides, I can't reveal all my secrets.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: How mysterious...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: You never know what I'm going to do next...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I think I have a good idea.
$Scott dips Angie.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Hee hee! Maybe not that!
$Scott takes Angie in his arms and starts to twirl her onto the dance floor...
Only to collide with other dancing couples!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Watch it, that's my leg you kicked!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Sorry!
$Scott steers Angie to another corner of the dance floor and twirls her into another girl!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Ow! $Scott, my nose!
$Scott helps Angie over to the side of the dance stage where she puts ice on her nose.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Sorry, Angie. Guess I should've let you take the lead one that one.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Maybe next time.

nodes.speaker: Spike

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Eeeeeep!

nodes.text: What's wrong? Why did the making out stop?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Hector, there's a `goblin` over there... And it's looking right at me. It's `creepy!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Hector, there's a [color=#3b78e2][i]goblin[/i][/color] over there... And it's looking right at me. It's [color=#3b78e2][i]creepy![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Come on, Amanda, not this again! Last time you saw a goblin, it was just lunchlady Gladys...
Hector looks over.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Aggghhhh! A `goblin!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Aggghhhh! A [color=#e23b3b][i]goblin![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Well, at least the nerds are having fun.
And finally, on the evening of the Valentine's Day Ball...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Despite how random all the suggestions were, I have to say I'm proud of how things turned out.
Orcs and goblins invading the Valentine's Day Ball for their Ward of the Rings convention?! That might make the nerds happy, but not anyone else!
Try again and see if you can make $Scott's dance work for everyone!
Or, if you want to know what's going on with $USR this Valentine's Day, check out 'Football: Valentine's Carnival', available now in the On Demand section!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: And there wasn't even any glitter!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I even disappointed Amanda?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Maybe Justin can avert this crisis today?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I think something at the snack bar made me sick, $Scott. I'm sorry I can't be of more help.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: And Travis tried to make a mosh pit by punching Spike...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Attracted by the swarm, more orcs and goblins started rushing the room and soliciting the snack table for keychains and signatures.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Orcs and goblins?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: This is great! It's like something out of Ward of the Kings!
And around Hannah and Mona, many of the goblins congregate.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Eep!

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: Away, foul beasts!
But with a few better choices, it could've gone a little better. Try again to get the perfect ending to see what others were doing during the Valentine's Ball!
See you next time on Surviving High School!
Or you can check out 'Football: Valentine's Carnival' in the On Demand section if you want to know what's going on with $USR this Valentine's Day!

nodes.speaker: Justin

nodes.speaker: Scott

nodes.speaker: Zoe

nodes.speaker: Scott

nodes.speaker: Angie

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I'll miss you when you're gone.

nodes.speaker: Angie

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Taylor, you have a date, and you're going to be crowned... Can we talk about who's going to be the top of the pyramid now?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Later, Sam. $Scott! I hope you upheld your end of the bargain.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Bargain?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: The one where I win Queen of Hearts, and you buy me a crown?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Great. I look forward to it.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I'm surprised you came, Justin.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I wanted to see whether the suggestion box worked. Looks like the dance is going well.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: But the night's still young, $Scott. Plenty of time for things to go wrong.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: You're just mad that everyone seems to be enjoying themselves.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I wouldn't say `everyone.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I wouldn't say [color=#e23b3b][i]everyone.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: What's that supposed to mean?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Your girlfriend doesn't look that happy. Did you even read her suggestion?
Justin walks away.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: That guy... Is so creepy!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: But he does have a point... I didn't even ask Angie what she wanted!
At that moment, Angie comes up to $Scott and kisses him.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Hello. What'd I miss?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Angie, I've been running around making everyone else's suggestions work. But I never asked... What do you want?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Is that why you look so worried? All I want to do is ballroom dance.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Dance? Now that, I can do!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Do you want to lead, or shall I?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: The guy normally leads, but Angie seems to know more about this than me...
$Scott takes his place in front of the podium.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Good evening, Centerscore High! Your votes are in, and the ballots have been counted.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: It's time to announce the Queen of Hearts at our lovely Valentine's Day Ball!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: The Queen of Hearts this year is... `Sam!`
nodes.text_bbcode: The Queen of Hearts this year is... [color=#e23b3b][i]Sam![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Congratulations, Sam!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Good job, Sam.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yay! What did Sam win again?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But... But how is that possible?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: With all your matchmaking. Helping hearts naturally makes you the Queen of Hearts!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: You're the one who gave us good advice, so we all voted for you.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You deserve it, Sam. Even if you didn't want to play matchmaker!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I... I don't know what to say.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You can say good-bye to your promotion for one...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Taylor!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: But congratulations, I guess.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Here's our Queen of Hearts!
The entire gym bursts into applause.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: And now for the Queen of Hearts dance...
Colt leads Sam to the dance floor where they sway in time to the music.
Justin walks up to $Scott.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I don't know how you did it, but you managed to make some kind of dance out of everyone's requests.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: That was your suggestion?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Maybe. So what? A guy likes balloon animals.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Wow, thanks, Justin.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Whoa, I'm not here to compliment you. You know, I'd like to see you take on a real challenge.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Things won't come up roses forever, $Scott. Something big is going to happen, and when it does...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: We'll see who's able to carry the Presidential mantle.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: What does that even mean?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Right now, you have the title, the girl, and the popularity. But you can't have everything your way. The higher you rise... The harder you fall.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Good night, President.
Justin walks off, as Angie comes up to $Scott.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I just don't get that guy.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Why? What did Justin say?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Nothing. Don't worry about it.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Well, good job, $Scott. It may have been chaotic, but you did it! Everyone's happy that you took their comments seriously, and the dance was successful.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Have I told you lately what a great President and boyfriend you are?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I could stand to hear it again.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: You're a great President and boyfriend, $Scott.
Angie kisses $Scott.
Thanks to you, $Scott pulled off another school dance and satisfied all the students!
You did a great job!

args.text: Thanks for playing! See you in another episode!

nodes.text: ...To find the students in uproar!
Maria hobbles past $Scott towards the door.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Maria? What happened to you?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: I fell into a table and broke my arm when people mobbed the door. .

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: What? Why is everyone running away?

nodes.text: Ahhhhh! There are `things` in the gym!
nodes.text_bbcode: Ahhhhh! There are [color=#3b78e2][i]things[/i][/color] in the gym!

nodes.text: There are what?
Jessica points where a large muddle of costumed people in the center of the room knock tables over.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I don't even think those are Centerscore students...
Jessica and a handful of other students swarm the exit to the dance hall.
$Scott finds Justin in the middle of the throng of people trying to leave.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Justin, what's going on here?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I'd be happy to tell you, President...
In the corner, Travis and Spike brawl, pulling down other unsuspecting party-goers.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: And I think a fire has started in the kitchen...

Angie walks away.

nodes.speaker: Justin

nodes.text: One fine Saturday at school, $Scott, Angie, and Justin are hard at work in the Centerscore High Student Lounge...

nodes.text: This emergency meeting of Student Council is now in session.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Thanks for coming in on a Saturday. On the agenda today is...

nodes.text: Limiting the powers of the executive branch?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Not exactly...

nodes.text: I'm noticing a disturbing trend during your reign as president, $Scott.

nodes.text_bbcode: What is this? A valentine? [color=#e23b3b][i]Someone[/i][/color] needs an extra lesson in the new statutes at this school...

nodes.speaker: Stern Man
nodes.text: W.A.S.P., take him away!
A uniformed group of students hauls Alexei to his feet.

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Hey! Watch it! You can't grab me like that.

nodes.speaker: Stern Man
nodes.text: You'll find, young man, that as the principal of this school, I can do whatever it is I want.

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: You won't take me. I won't learn the statutes... `I will ignore them!`
nodes.text_bbcode: You won't take me. I won't learn the statutes... [color=#e23b3b][i]I will ignore them![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Whoa, looks like some dark things are going on at Wilson... Come back soon to see what's going at Wilson...
But for now, feel good that everyone seems to be enjoying their Valentine's Day dance!
That's your bonus scene! See you next time on Surviving High School!
Plus, check out 'Football: Valentine's Carnival' in the On Demand section if you want to know what's going on with $USR this Valentine's Day!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Attracted by the spaceship, a herd of aliens started swarming the room and soliciting the snack table for keychains and signatures.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Aliens?
Around $Scott, nerdy-looking kids dressed up in uniforms and alien costumes roam around.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: This is `awesome!` It's just like a real Star Tracks convention with all the Trackies! Stay healthy and thrive!
nodes.text_bbcode: This is [color=#e23b3b][i]awesome![/i][/color] It's just like a real Star Tracks convention with all the Trackies! Stay healthy and thrive!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: And Travis tried to make the mosh pit more intense by punching Spike...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I think I twisted my ankle when you stepped on my foot earlier, $Scott. I'm sorry I can't be of more help.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Though maybe you can get `Linda` to help you since she's the one you really wanted to walk down the red carpet with.
nodes.text_bbcode: Though maybe you can get [color=#3b78e2][i]Linda[/i][/color] to help you since she's the one you really wanted to walk down the red carpet with.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: What?! I was just trying to help the girls out.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I'm `sure.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]sure.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: At least there was glitter.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Sorry, Amanda, but I don't think glitter's going to save us now.
Aliens and Trackies invading the Valentine's Day Ball for their Star Tracks convention?! That might make the nerds happy, but not anyone else!
Try again and see if you can make $Scott's dance work for everyone!
